channel.title: Not Always Right - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Not Always Right (notalwaysright.com)

item.title: The Solution Is Clickbait
item.description: Caller: "I run a small business; I don't have time to read emails!" Me: "Which is why you've been on hold for half an hour for me to tell you to click on that annoying pop-up to tell it that "yes" you would like to update the software."

item.title: Key-p Your Eyes Open
item.description: My friend and I are driving to college together; she's driving. Suddenly, out of nowhere, she shouts: Friend: "F***!" Me: "What is it?!" Friend: "I forgot my keys!"

item.title: That's How Californians Roll
item.description: Customer: "I want the California rolls, but without the crab." Me: "So, did you want the veggie rolls?" Customer: "No, I want the California rolls, but without the crab."

item.title: French Toasted/Roasted
item.description: We’re on a very crowded bus in Nice, and my spouse starts hyperventilating. I start giving her a massage to calm her down. A man, jokingly, demands in French: Man: "Est-ce que je le-recevrai?" *Could I get one?*

item.title: Getting Both Sides Of The Story
item.description: Brother-In-Law: "I'm dyslexic." Mother-In-Law: "He was dyslexic. Now he’s in college!" Me: "You can’t get into college with dyslexia? What did the healer do?" Mother-In-Law: "He said we have to rub the right side of his head for ten minutes, then the left."

item.title: Thermodynamics, You Take It From Here, Part 30
item.description: Customer: "The machine isn't dispensing ice!" Me: "We know. A repair guy was called, but he's not here yet. In the meantime, there's a bowl next to the soda fountain, so you can still get ice."

item.title: Too Few To Chew
item.description: Me: "That's weird. We should still have twenty more lunch sacks. ? Is there another box of lunches on the bus?" Coworker: "Huh? Oh no, that was all that I requested."
